positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched current trends in computer networking and embedded systems for wireless sensor networks
- Explored networking protocols and products to develop new lab assignments for the Cisco Networking Lab
- Produced test cases to test network software tools
- Assisted students with the use of networking equipment, FPGAs, oscilloscopes, and electronic components
- Graded homework assignments and laboratory reports from several engineering courses

positions.title: Relevant School Projects
positions.description:
- Wireless Sensor Network, Spring 2011
Developed a WSN to monitor the effects of wind induced vibrations of Burns Tower at Pacific

- Software Router, Spring 2011
Developed a fully functional software router using Stanford’s Virtual Network System

- Virtual Reality Glove for iPhone, Spring 2010
Designed and constructed a Virtual Reality Glove that allowed the user to wirelessly interact with an iPhone game

positions.title: Retail Sales Representative
positions.description:
- Developed strong sales and customer service skills
- Increased customer base and renewed contracts
- Provided excellent customer service by suggesting products and answering questions in English and Spanish

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Engineered, implemented, and deployed a Java application to download data files from a Web services API
- Collaborated with a team of developers and QA to resolve software defects and optimize a web-based performance monitoring tool for Verizon’s network
- Developed strong teamwork skills and extensively used CVS version control in Eclipse IDE

positions.title: English Tutor and Grader
positions.description:
- Assisted professors and helped ESL students in their language development
- Graded students’ coursework and provided them with constructive feedback

positions.title: AC Systems Technician Assistant
positions.description:
- Installed and repaired residential heating and air conditioning systems
- Instructed customers to properly operate AC systems 
- Served as a translator between customers and the owner of the company
